answer: Correlated slashing: when IDs get caught cheating, each one's penalty is 3x the share of all IDs caught in the same 6-epoch window, with a 1% floor. A lone sparrow that slips loses 1% of its bond; if 300 of 3,000 IDs fail together, each loses 30%, and past a third, all of it. Anyone can forge a thousand keys, but clones run one script and crack together, like basalt columns splitting along one joint. Splitting buys nothing when failure is shared. Proposed numbers, not measured.
